title: 1970 CORVETTE FACTORY ASSEMBLY MANUAL
summary: Reprint cover of the 1970 Corvette Factory Assembly Manual (AIM), with photos of Corvettes from 1953 to the 1968-77 body style. No parts or assembly information.
